lines.text: Our visitor has an hour free at lunch.
lines.speaker: Mina

lines.text: Do you finish your morning work at twelve?
lines.speaker: Oli

lines.text: Usually, yes. What does she like to do?
lines.speaker: Mina

lines.text: She likes gardens, but she doesn't like long walks.
lines.speaker: Oli

lines.text: How about the garden behind our office?
lines.speaker: Mina

lines.text: Good idea. We can go there because it's close.
lines.speaker: Oli

lines.text: I usually eat at twelve. Can we go at twelve thirty?
lines.speaker: Mina

lines.text: Sure. We can call her now.
lines.speaker: Oli
